notes: One prompt, one build, every criterion met — the second clean 8 of 8 on this brief, and the first one that cost nothing but tokens. Bolt wrote a client-side app: the three series pages are views, not addresses, so a search engine only ever sees the home page, and the contact form confirms without storing anything. The design is the strongest of the Bolt runs so far (serif headings, hairline rules, no cards), and the photographs are picsum images — plausible in a grid, but a laptop and a mountain range give away that nobody curated them. No horizontal scroll at 320, 390 or 430 px, no console errors; axe reports 22 contrast findings on the grey caption text, which is the one visible weakness.
